36652.title: Badagry Heritage Museum
36652.extract: Badagry Heritage Museum is a museum in Badagry, Nigeria that is housed in the District Officer's Office built in 1863 by the British colonial government. The museum is managed by the Nigerian Cultural Commission.

17532.title: Seriki Williams Abass Slave Museum
17532.extract: The Seriki Williams Abass Slave Museum is a historical site located in Badagry, Lagos State, Nigeria. Established in the early 1840s, serving both as the compound of Seriki Williams Abass and a place for holding slaves during the transatlantic slave trade.

306101.title: Lagos Trade Fair Complex
306101.extract: The Lagos International Trade Fair Complex is a 350 hectares (860 acres) facility in Satellite Town, Lagos along Lagos-Badagry Expressway hosting a number of market traders. The facility was constructed in the 1970s and planned to host an international trade fair upon fulfillment.

689666.title: Kirikiri Maximum Security Prison
689666.extract: Kirikiri Maximum Security Prison is a prison west of Apapa, Lagos State, Nigeria. It is named after the rural Kirikiri community in which it is situated.

32455.title: Eko Pearl Towers
32455.extract: Eko Pearl Towers is a complex which consists of five residential towers in Eko Atlantic, Lagos State.

61802.title: Federal College of Fisheries and Marine Technology
61802.extract: The Federal College of Fisheries and Marine Technology is a higher education institute located on Victoria Island in Lagos, Nigeria. It is a monotechnic approved by the National Board for Technical Education.

834865.title: Federal Palace Hotel
834865.extract: The Federal Palace Hotel is a luxury hotel and casino in Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria. The hotel is notable for having been the setting for the signing of Nigeria's Declaration of Independence.

69913.title: Remembrance Arcade (Lagos)
69913.extract: The Remembrance Arcade located at the Tafawa Balewa Square, Lagos, is a cenotaph site used to commemorate Nigerian soldiers who died in World War I, World War II and the Nigerian Civil War. It is located within the Tafawa Balewa Square in the Lagos Central Business District.

69937.title: GET Arena
69937.extract: GET Arena is a kart racing venue in Lekki, Lagos, Nigeria, opposite Oriental Hotel. It has been closed down permanently.

835700.title: The Wings Towers
835700.extract: The Wings Office Complex is a twin 15-storey grade A office building in Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria. The Towers which comprise 27,000 m2 (290,000 sq ft) of office space are also attributed to be green certified.

834082.title: Onikan Stadium
834082.extract: The Mobolaji Johnson Arena, previously known as Onikan Stadium, is a multi-purpose stadium in Lagos, Nigeria. It is currently used for football matches and is the home stadium of 1472 F.C, First Bank F.C, Ikorodu City F.C, Inter Lagos, Julius Berger F.C, Prince Kazeem Eleku F.C, Smart City F.C, Sporting Lagos, Stationery Stores F.C.

836612.title: Reddington Hospital
836612.extract: Reddington Hospital is a private hospital in Lagos, Nigeria.

834028.title: John Randle Centre for Yoruba Culture and History
834028.extract: The John Randle Centre for Yoruba Culture and History is a museum in Onikan (Lagos, Nigeria) that uses new technology to introduce visitors to Yoruba culture. It is situated in the immediate vicinity of the National Museum, the MUSON Conservatoire and Tafawa Balewa Square, where Nigeria’s independence was declared in 1960.

833932.title: Nigerian National Museum
833932.extract: The Nigerian National Museum is a national museum of Nigeria, located in the city of Lagos. The museum has a notable collection of Nigerian art, including pieces of statuary, carvings, and archaeological and ethnographic exhibits.

821418.title: NECOM House
821418.extract: NECOM House (formerly NITEL Tower and before that, the NET Building) is a skyscraper located in Lagos. The 32-storey building was completed in 1979, and houses the headquarters of NITEL.

71385.title: Eko Hotels and Suites
71385.extract: Eko Hotel and Suites is a five-star hotel and conference centre in Lagos, Nigeria.

821919.title: Independence House
821919.extract: Independence House is a 25-storey office building, this long time edifice is located west of Tafawa Balewa Square, Onikan Lagos. The project was commissioned by the British government as a testimonial to and as a good will support to Nigeria's independence in 1960.

821355.title: Lagos Island General Hospital
821355.extract: General Hospital, Lagos, is the oldest hospital in Nigeria.

821313.title: Freedom Park (Lagos)
821313.extract: Freedom Park is a memorial and leisure park area in the middle of downtown Lagos in Lagos Island, Nigeria which was formerly Her Majesty's Broad Street Prison. It was designed by the architect Theo Lawson as a speculative project under the CIA-Lagos (formerly the Creative Intelligence Agency and now the Cultural Intellectual Association) in 1999.

808296.title: Apapa Amusement Park
808296.extract: The Apapa Amusement Park is an amusement park in Lagos, Nigeria. The park was built in 2008 and it spans an area of approximately 3.1 ha (37,000 yd2).

821277.title: Holy Cross Cathedral, Lagos
821277.extract: Holy Cross Cathedral is a Roman Catholic cathedral located in Lagos, Nigeria, and is the seat of the Archdiocese of Lagos. The Gothic style building was constructed in 1939, when the region was still administered as an apostolic vicariate, and thus was only elevated to the status of cathedral in 1950.

821933.title: King's College, Lagos
821933.extract: King's College, Lagos (KCL) is a secondary school in Lagos, Lagos State, Nigeria. It was founded on 20 September 1909 with 10 students at Lagos Island, adjacent to Tafawa Balewa Square.

823507.title: Cathedral Church of Christ, Lagos
823507.extract: The Cathedral Church of Christ Marina, Lagos is an Anglican cathedral on Lagos Island, Lagos, Nigeria.

831216.title: First Consultant Hospital
831216.extract: First Consultant Hospital (also known as First Consultant Medical Centre) is a private hospital in Lagos. It is located on St.

823593.title: Bookshop House
823593.extract: Bookshop House (also called CSS Bookshop) is a building in the Lagos Island located at Northeastern part of Broad street at Odunlami street. It was designed by Godwin and Hopwood Architects and built in 1973.

823561.title: Union Bank Building (Lagos)
823561.extract: Union Bank Building is a skyscraper in Lagos. The 28-storey building serves as the headquarters of the Union Bank of Nigeria.

823741.title: Ilojo Bar
823741.extract: Ilojo Bar, also called Olaiya House or Casa da Fernandez, was a Brazilian-styled historic building located near Tinubu Square in Lagos Island, Lagos State, Nigeria. According to some sources, the building was originally built as a bar and restaurant in 1855 by the Fernandez family, who employed returning ex-slaves from Brazil and Cuba that had mastered the art of building while in the Western Hemisphere.

824010.title: Massey Street Children's Hospital
824010.extract: Massey Children's Hospital (a.k.a. Massey Street Children's Hospital) is a 85-bed pediatric state-owned treatment hospital headquartered in Lagos Island, Lagos State.

832448.title: Bogobiri House
832448.extract: Bogobiri House is an African-themed boutique hotel and restaurant located in 9 Maitama Sule Street Off Awolowo Road, South-West Ikoyi, Lagos, Nigeria.

64796.title: Snake Island Port
64796.extract: Snake Island Port is a multipurpose port facility located within Snake Island Integrated Free Zone in Lagos, Nigeria. The port covers an area of 85 hectares and includes three terminals with a total quay length of 2.5 kilometres.

845267.title: Civic Tower (Lagos)
845267.extract: The Civic Tower, also called Civic Centre Towers, Civic Towers, is a 17 floor office building in Lagos. It is located a short distance from the Civic Centre on Ozumba Mbadiwe Avenue, Victoria Island, Lagos.

830879.title: Dodan Barracks
830879.extract: Dodan Barracks is a military barrack located in Ikoyi, Lagos, Nigeria. The barrack was the Supreme Military Headquarters during the Nigerian Civil War and from 1966 to 1979 and 1983 to 1985, Dodan Barracks was the official residence of the military heads of state of the Nigerian military juntas of 1966–79 and 1983–99, and also the Supreme Military Headquarters from 1966 until the move to Abuja in 1991.

825300.title: Lagos Central Mosque
825300.extract: The Lagos Central Mosque is a jum'at mosque, located in Lagos Island, Lagos, the largest city in Nigeria. The mosque serves as the principal home of the Chief Imam of Lagos.

820108.title: Shitta-Bey Mosque
820108.extract: Shitta-Bey Mosque is a mosque, religious learning centre and one of the oldest mosques in Southern Nigeria and the first internationally recognised mosque in Nigeria. The mosque is located at Martins Ereko Street, Lagos Island, Lagos, Nigeria.

838002.title: American International School of Lagos
838002.extract: American International School of Lagos (AISL) is an American international school in Lagos, Nigeria serving preschool to grade 12. The school was founded in 1964.

819698.title: Soldier Idumota
819698.extract: Soldier Idumota (Yoruba: Sojadumota) sometimes called Unknown Soldier, is a cenotaph located in Idumota, a suburb of Lagos, in Lagos State, Nigeria.

829882.title: Muson Centre
829882.extract: The MUSON Centre (Musical Society of Nigeria) is a performance hall in Lagos. The multipurpose civic auditorium is located in the centre of Lagos Island, situated between the National Museum, the City Mall, the Onikan Stadium and the former official residence of Nigeria's Governors-General, and adjacent to Tafawa Balewa Square.

845540.title: Corona School, Ikoyi
845540.extract: Corona School, Ikoyi is a co-educational independent school for children from ages 5 to 11. The school is a member of the Council of British International Schools, the Association of International Schools in Africa and governed by the Corona Schools' Trust Council.

904461.title: Iga Idunganran
904461.extract: Iga Idunganran is the Official Residence of the Oba of Lagos, situated on Lagos Island, in Lagos, Nigeria.

841364.title: British International School Lagos
841364.extract: British International School Lagos (BIS) is a British international school in Oniru Private Estate in Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria. Opening in 2001, the school provides the National Curriculum for England to day and boarding students aged 11–18.

903998.title: Lagos Terminus railway station
903998.extract: Lagos Terminus, also known as Lagos Iddo, has been the main railway station of the city of Lagos until 2021. The rail terminus is located on Iddo Island, nearby Lagos Island, near the Lagos mainland.

847396.title: Lagos Preparatory School
847396.extract: Lagos Preparatory & Secondary School (LPSS) is a private co-educational day school in the affluent Ikoyi suburb of Lagos, Nigeria, and has adopted the UK National Curriculum; it was established in 2002. LPSS which was formerly known as LPS, provides Early Years, Primary and Secondary school education for children from 18 months up to age 16+.

841338.title: Palms Shopping Mall
841338.extract: The Palms Shopping Mall is located on a 45,000-square-metre (11-acre) plot of land in Lekki, Lagos State. It has 21,000 square metres (5 acres) of lettable retail space.

685290.title: German School Lagos
685290.extract: German School Lagos (German: Deutsche Schule Lagos; DSL) was a German international school in Apapa, Lagos State, Nigeria for pupils in years 1–13. It was a part of the Deutsche Schulen Nigeria (DS-Nigeria or DSN) system, which includes the Deutsche Schule Abuja.

897807.title: National Theatre, Nigeria
897807.extract: The National Theatre, Nigeria now known as The Wole Soyinka Center for Culture and Creative Arts, Nigeria is the primary centre for the performing arts in Nigeria. It shares the same architectural design as the Palace of Culture and Sports in Varna, Bulgaria, and it is four times bigger.

840934.title: Dowen College
840934.extract: Dowen College is a co-educational college located in Lekki, a suburb of Lagos. The college admits both boarding and day pupils between the ages of 11 and 18 years.

906921.title: Longford International School
906921.extract: Longford International School is a proprietary co-educational high school in Ebute Metta, Lagos, Nigeria. The school offers both Senior School and Junior School Certificate Examinations.

913071.title: Federal Medical Centre, Ebute Metta
913071.extract: Federal Medical Centre Ebute-Metta, Lagos is a tertiary hospital located in Nigerian Railway Corporation Compound in Ebute-Metta, Lagos.

916214.title: Jaekel House
916214.extract: The Jaekel House is a 2-storey colonial mansion in Ebute Metta, Lagos, Nigeria. The house was built in 1898 on a large expanse of landscaped land and named after the late Francis Jaekel OBE, a former superintendent of the Nigerian Railway Corporation who retired in the 1970s after almost three decades of active service.

869094.title: House on the Rock (church)
869094.extract: House on the Rock is an Evangelical Christian Church headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It is well known for its annual musical concert, The Experience (World's Largest Gospel Concert), which features both local and international gospel musicians.

867987.title: Meadow Hall School
867987.extract: Meadow Hall is a private school in Lekki, Lagos, Nigeria. Founded in July 2002 by Kehinde Nwani, the school uses a combination of the English National Curriculum and the Nigerian Curriculum.

867867.title: Nike Art Gallery
867867.extract: The Nike Art Gallery is West Africa’s most extensive art collection. Its biggest and most famous branch is situated in the Lekki district of the Lagos metropolitan area, Nigeria.

1308958.title: Dreamworld Africana
1308958.extract: Dreamworld Africana is an amusement and theme park situated in Lekki, Lagos State. Established in 2013, Dreamworld covers an area of 4.05 ha (10.0 acres) and re-opened to the public in 2018.

1328688.title: Greensprings School
1328688.extract: Greensprings School is a British international private school in Nigeria. It was established in the year 1985, in Anthony Village, Lagos.

1318509.title: Caleb British International School
1318509.extract: Caleb British International School (CBIS) is a co-educational Day/Boarding school in Abijo G.R.A Lekki, Lagos State, Nigeria. The school is an arm of Caleb Group of Schools, which has been in existence for over 30 years.

1316904.title: LUFASI Park
1316904.extract: LUFASI Park is a 20-hectare nature park on the outskirts of Lagos, Nigeria, that specialises in eco-tourism. LUFASI stands for Lekki Urban Forestry and Animal Shelter Initiative and is situated at KM41 on the Lekki-Epe Expressway.

1460005.title: Yemisi Shyllon Museum of Art
1460005.extract: The Yemisi Shyllon Museum of Art is a privately-owned museum located on the main campus of the Pan-Atlantic University in Lagos State, Nigeria.

340859.title: Federal Government College, Ijanikin
340859.extract: The Federal Government College, Ijanikin is a co-educational secondary school in Alasia, Lagos, Nigeria. It was established by the Federal Ministry of Education in 1975.

506696.title: Lagos Theatre, Igando
506696.extract: The Lagos Theatre, Igando is a performance theatre located in Lagos, Nigeria. It is one of four theatres established by the Lagos State Government's Ministry of Tourism, Arts, and Culture during Governor Akinwunmi Ambode's administration.

1025187.title: Synagogue Church of All Nations
1025187.extract: The Synagogue Church Of All Nations (SCOAN) is a charismatic Christian megachurch located in Lagos, Nigeria. The Church was founded in 1987 and has a presence across the globe with over 50,000 individuals attending service weekly.

1069570.title: Binta International School
1069570.extract: Binta International Schools is a group of schools founded by Mrs.Ehi Adenuga and located in Lagos State. It operates a creche, nursery, basic and high school.

992738.title: Isolo General Hospital
992738.extract: Isolo General Hospital is a public healthcare facility located in Isolo, Lagos, Nigeria. It provides medical services to residents of Isolo and surrounding areas, offering a range of healthcare services, including emergency care, maternity services, outpatient consultations, and specialized treatments.

1159475.title: Federal College of Education (Technical), Akoka
1159475.extract: The Federal College of Education (Technical), Akoka (formerly National Technical Teachers College) is a Nigerian technical tertiary institution located in Akoka, a suburb of Yaba in Lagos. Founded in 1967 by the Federal Government of Nigeria, the institution was founded with the aim of "grooming and producing teachers in technical, vocational and commercial academic disciplines".

1155401.title: International School Lagos
1155401.extract: The International School University of Lagos (often ISL or International School Lagos) is a fee-charging, co-educational secondary school located on the campus of University of Lagos (UNILAG) in Akoka, Lagos, Nigeria. The school was established on 9 November 1981.

1166403.title: CMS Grammar School, Lagos
1166403.extract: The CMS Grammar School in Bariga, a suburb of Lagos in Lagos State, is the oldest secondary school in Nigeria, founded on 6 June 1859 by the Church Missionary Society. For decades it was the main source of African clergymen and administrators in the Lagos Colony.

933559.title: Queen's College, Lagos
933559.extract: Queen's College, Lagos, is a government-owned girls' secondary (high) school with boarding facilities, situated in Yaba, Lagos, Nigeria. Often referred to as the "sister college" of King's College, Lagos, it was founded on October 10, 1927, when Nigeria was still a British colony.

1139756.title: Igbobi College
1139756.extract: Igbobi College is a college established by the Methodist and Anglican Churches in 1932, in the Yaba suburb of Lagos, Lagos State, South-western Nigeria. It is still on its original site and most of the original buildings are intact.

932036.title: Lebanese Community School
932036.extract: The Lebanese International School is a private school in Yaba, Lagos, Nigeria. Commissioned in 1964 by the Lebanese embassy with classes ranging from kindergarten to twelfth grade, the embassy is still in charge of the school's board of trustees, which includes the Lebanese ambassador.

1150805.title: Yaba Bus Terminal
1150805.extract: Yaba Bus Terminal is located along the Murtala Mohammed Way, Yaba Local Council Development Area in Lagos Mainland, an area of Lagos State, Nigeria. Yaba is a suburb which is located on the mainland in Lagos state.

931448.title: Federal Neuro-Psychiatric Hospital, Yaba
931448.extract: The Federal Neuropsychiatric Hospital, which is also known as Yaba Psychiatric Hospital, but popularly known as Yaba Left, is a Nigerian Federal psychiatric hospital in Yaba, a suburb of Lagos, dedicated to providing mental services, conducting research and training professionals.

1174823.title: Grace Schools
1174823.extract: Grace Schools is a co-educational school founded in Gbagada, Lagos, Nigeria in the year 1968. The school is divided into four sections: the Nursery, the Primary, Secondary School and the Pre-University.

1177583.title: Gbagada General Hospital
1177583.extract: Gbagada General Hospital is a general hospital in Lagos, Nigeria.

1136594.title: Lagos Baptist Academy
1136594.extract: Lagos Baptist Academy is a Baptist secondary school located in Obanikoro, Lagos, Nigeria. The school is regarded as a sister school to Reagan Memorial Baptist Girls' Secondary School, Yaba, Lagos and Baptist Girls' Academy, Obanikoro, Lagos.

1113120.title: College of Medicine, University of Lagos
1113120.extract: College of Medicine, University of Lagos (CMUL) also known as Medilag is the medical school affiliated with the University of Lagos in Nigeria. It is located in Idi-Araba, Lagos beside its sister institution, the Lagos University Teaching Hospital.

896820.title: National Stadium, Lagos
896820.extract: The Lagos National Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in Surulere, Lagos State, Nigeria. It comprises an Olympic-size swimming arena and a multipurpose arena used for athletics, rugby union, basketball, volleyball, table tennis, wrestling and boxing matches.

886201.title: Randle General Hospital
886201.extract: Randle General Hospital is a state general hospital in the Surulere district of Lagos, Nigeria. It was established for community use in 1964 by Chief Majekodunmi and it was one of the first health care clinics in Surulere.

892471.title: Teslim Balogun Stadium
892471.extract: The Teslim Balogun Stadium is a multi-use stadium in Surulere, Lagos, Nigeria. It is used mostly for football matches and serves as a home ground of First Bank FC.

1112961.title: Lagos University Teaching Hospital
1112961.extract: Lagos University Teaching Hospital (LUTH) is a tertiary hospital established in 1962 and is located in Idi-Araba, Surulere, Lagos State, Nigeria. The teaching hospital is affiliated with the University of Lagos College of Medicine.

1134145.title: Indian Language School
1134145.extract: The Indian Language School was established in Lagos, Nigeria in 1982 in light of the growing Indian community in the city. The school is under the Indian high commission in Nigeria and managed by a Board of Trustees made up of prominent businesspeople.

1221754.title: Redeemer's International Secondary School
1221754.extract: The Redeemer's International Secondary School is a co-educational private secondary school located in Maryland, Lagos, Nigeria. It was founded in 1997.

1005421.title: Isolo Public library
1005421.extract: Isolo Public library is one of the 18 libraries established in Lagos State to encourage a reading culture in the residents of the state. It is under the Lagos State library board.

991925.title: Apata Memorial High School
991925.extract: Apata Memorial High School is a military-style privately owned boarding school in Lagos, Nigeria. It was founded in 1980 by retired Nigerian Army Brigadier-General S.

1213757.title: MKO Abiola Park
1213757.extract: The MKO Abiola Park is a public park located at the Ikododu Road - Lagos/Ibadan Expressway Interchange in Ojota, Lagos. The green space was named after the Late Nigerian Politician and Philanthropist MKO Abiola.

1090423.title: Ikeja City Mall
1090423.extract: The Ikeja City Mall is located at Alausa in Ikeja, Lagos State. It is the first of its kind on the Mainland of Metropolitan Lagos.

1202672.title: Lagos State University Teaching Hospital
1202672.extract: Lagos State University Teaching Hospital popularly known as LASUTH is a state-owned teaching hospital in Lagos, Nigeria, attached to the Lagos State University. It is in Ikeja – the state's capital.

1090274.title: Murtala Muhammed International Airport
1090274.extract: Murtala Muhammed International Airport (MMIA) (IATA: LOS, ICAO: DNMM) is an international airport located in Ikeja, Lagos State, Nigeria, and is the major airport serving the entire state. The airport was initially built during World War II and is named after Murtala Muhammed (1938–1976), the fourth head of state of Nigeria.

1526650.title: Egbin Thermal Power Station
1526650.extract: Egbin Power Plc is the largest power generating station in Nigeria, with an installed capacity of 1,320 MW consisting of 6 Units of 220MW each. The station is located at Ijede / Egbin, in Ikorodu.

1607558.title: Epe Central Mosque
1607558.extract: First Epe Central Mosque is a historic mosque located in Epe, Lagos State, Nigeria built in 1862. It is regarded as one of the earliest surviving Islamic landmarks in Lagos and reflects the growth of Islam in the town during the nineteenth century.

1684662.title: Lagos State Model Junior College Meiran
1684662.extract: Lagos State Model Junior College Meiran is a state owned secondary school located in Oke Odo, in the northern part of the city of Lagos, Nigeria.

1777819.title: Ndubuisi Kanu Park
1777819.extract: The Kanu Ndubuisi Park is a public park and recreational center located in Ikeja, Lagos. It is a green space created and managed by the Lagos State Parks and Garden Agency.

1777864.title: Johnson Jakande Tinubu Park
1777864.extract: The Johnson Jakande Tinubu Park is a public park located in Ikeja, the capital of Lagos. The park which was commissioned by the then Lagos State Governor, Akinwunmi Ambode in December 2017 as a recreational space located within the proximity of The Office of the Governor, the Lagos State House of Assembly and the State Secretariat.

1789878.title: Vivian Fowler Memorial College for Girls
1789878.extract: The Vivian Fowler Memorial College for Girls is an all-girls Independent college founded in 1991 by Chief Mrs. Leila Fowler in Nigeria.

1749295.title: Agege Stadium
1749295.extract: Agege Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in Lagos, Nigeria. It has a seating capacity of 4,000.

1673385.title: Yaba College of Technology
1673385.extract: Yaba College of Technology, popularly known as YABATECH, was founded in 1947, and is Nigeria's first higher educational institution. It is located in Yaba, Lagos.

1985039.title: Badagry General Hospital
1985039.extract: Badagry General Hospital is a public healthcare facility located in Badagry, Lagos State, Nigeria. It provides a range of medical services to the residents of Badagry and its neighboring communities.

2144209.title: Babington Macaulay Junior Seminary
2144209.extract: Babington Macaulay Junior Seminary is a private co-educational school in Agunfoye-Lugbusi Village, Ikorodu, Lagos Nigeria. It is jointly owned by three Anglican dioceses in the Lagos Province – Lagos, Lagos West and Lagos Mainland, Church of Nigeria.
